_about: Notes written by an AI reviewer after viewing whole-document contact sheets at low resolution, PDF and LibreOffice DOCX. They are not human judgements. Fine typography cannot be judged at this size.

annual_report.baseline: Every page has the same composition: orange band, black footer, rainbow chart, a drop cap on each section, no cover.
annual_report.executive_premium: Photo cover, large hero figure on the performance page, quiet rules. Strongest presence, but 9 pages against 6 and some pages hold little. DOCX in LibreOffice follows the PDF closely.
annual_report.editorial_modern: Image-top cover, hanging text, a bleed band and grotesque headings: clearly a different publication. The band crop clips the top of the moon slightly.
annual_report.financial_data: Dense masthead, slabs and a KPI band in 4 pages. Reads as a data report, and is tight rather than elegant.

financial_statements.baseline: Tables and charts are legible, but with the same band and rainbow bars as every other document.
financial_statements.financial_data: Best fit: 3 pages, tinted current column, firm slabs. The last page holds a short table only.
financial_statements.corporate_conservative: Formal and calm. Pages are half filled for a document this short.
financial_statements.executive_premium: Dark cover and generous type look premium, though generous spacing costs two pages over financial_data.

board_paper.baseline: Two tidy pages, but the drop cap on every section is out of place in a decision paper.
board_paper.corporate_conservative: Band title, numbered sections, ledger table. Suits the document.
board_paper.financial_data: Compact and clear. In DOCX only the last section reaches the second page, which looks thin.
board_paper.executive_premium: Serif headings under rules give a measured look on two pages.

technical_manual.baseline: Usable; decoration adds nothing for a manual.
technical_manual.financial_data: Compact with slabs: easiest to scan.
technical_manual.corporate_conservative: Numbered sections suit a manual. The appendix sits alone on the last page.
technical_manual.executive_premium: Dark cover feels heavy for a manual, and a table header caption moves with its table across a page.

research_paper.baseline: References title is doubled because the block and the heading both print it. This comes from the source structure and remains in every design.
research_paper.corporate_conservative: Closest to a paper: centred cover, numbered sections, serif text.
research_paper.financial_data: Compact, but the last PDF page holds only the references.
research_paper.executive_premium: Largest growth and half-empty pages. The weakest fit for a paper.

proposal.baseline: Large images and repeated drop caps; the last page is mostly empty.
proposal.editorial_modern: Most convincing: hero band, hanging text, side image with wrapping. After the fix, headings in DOCX start below the float.
proposal.corporate_conservative: Team sits alone on the last PDF page; refinement did not pull it back. Page 2 is half empty.

impact_report.baseline: Same band and footer; one chart in rainbow colours.
impact_report.editorial_modern: Strong: masthead, bleed photograph, float image, large quote.
impact_report.executive_premium: Good cover and rhythm. Its last section is short.
impact_report.corporate_conservative: Sound, but the last PDF page is mostly empty.

policy_brief.baseline: Two pages with a rainbow chart.
policy_brief.corporate_conservative: Clear, but the recommendation sits alone on a near-empty third PDF page: refinement tried and failed. A weak ending for a brief.
policy_brief.financial_data: Best of the three here: two full pages, recommendation included. In DOCX the last section is alone on page 2.
policy_brief.editorial_modern: Bold headings, but the recommendation also sits alone on the last PDF page.

arabic_annual.baseline: Arabic is correct and right aligned, but with the same band and footer as the English documents.
arabic_annual.arabic_institutional: Split cover and bleed slabs mirrored for Arabic: the most institutional. DOCX slabs are inset rather than bleeding; they were invisible before the band style fix.
arabic_annual.executive_premium: Opening page with a chapter strip and a large hero figure work well in Arabic. 8 pages against 4.
arabic_annual.editorial_modern: Large image bands, but page 4 holds three lines: refinement tried and the change was undone.

arabic_financial.arabic_institutional: Compact, slabs and last-bar emphasis. LibreOffice DOCX runs one page longer than the PDF.
arabic_financial.financial_data: Two dense pages with a KPI slab: the clearest for a financial statement.
arabic_financial.corporate_conservative: Now unnumbered in Arabic after a digit placed at the wrong end was seen. Calm, one page longer.

bilingual_institutional.baseline: Both languages present and legible, no structure beyond the band.
bilingual_institutional.arabic_institutional: Slab headings carry both languages; finance table has a tinted column. Title line ends on the separator, a minor flaw.
bilingual_institutional.executive_premium: Serif headings suit the pairing and fit in three pages.
bilingual_institutional.corporate_conservative: Centred cover; metric labels are pale. The last page is short.

sustainability_report.baseline: The last page is a split table, mostly empty.
sustainability_report.financial_data: Three pages, KPI slab, tinted column, last-bar emphasis. Clear, but the last page is mostly empty.
sustainability_report.executive_premium: Image-led cover, calm pages. Page 4 has a lower half left empty.
sustainability_report.editorial_modern: Bleed image and big headings give pace; the hanging indent makes columns feel narrow.
